title: 해도 안 될 때, 그저 감사할 때: -을래야 / -을 따름이다
objective: By the end, you can form -을래야 -을 수 없다 and -을 따름이다 correctly, and choose the right one when you say you can't do something or speak politely about your feelings or actions.
summary: This worksheet compares two patterns: -을래야 -을 수 없다 ("can't, even if I try") and -을 따름이다 ("simply/only this, nothing more").

task.title: Use the two patterns
task.line: Fill in the blanks, fix the mistake, or choose the right form for each situation.

forms.form: V-을래야 V-을 수(가) 없다 (stem ends in a consonant)
forms.when: You want or try to do something, but the situation makes it impossible. Use the same verb twice.
forms.means: can't do it, even if I try / no matter how much I want to
forms.example: 그 사람 얼굴은 잊을래야 잊을 수가 없어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I can't forget that person's face, even if I try.

forms.form: V-ㄹ래야 V-ㄹ 수(가) 없다 (stem ends in a vowel or ㄹ)
forms.when: Same meaning. For ㄹ stems, add only 래야: 만들다 → 만들래야.
forms.means: can't do it, even if I try
forms.example: 집 앞에서 공사를 해서 잘래야 잘 수가 없어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: There's construction in front of my house, so I can't sleep even if I try.

forms.when: Formal speech: thank-you speeches, apologies, interviews. Often used with 그저 or 다만.
forms.means: I simply feel / do only this, nothing more
forms.example: 이렇게 와 주셔서 그저 감사할 따름입니다.
forms.exampleMeaning: I'm simply grateful that you came.

forms.when: Use this to say humbly that you only did something small in the past.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was only doing my job.

watchOut: 먹을래야 먹었어요 (X) → 먹을래야 먹을 수가 없었어요 (O): The second part must say that you could not do it.
감사한 따름입니다 (X) → 감사할 따름입니다 (O): Always use -을/ㄹ before 따름, even in the present.
만들을래야 (X) → 만들래야 (O): For ㄹ stems, add only 래야.
듣을래야 (X) → 들을래야 (O): ㄷ irregular verbs change ㄷ to ㄹ before 을.
궁금할 따름이야 (X, to a friend) → 궁금할 뿐이야 (O): -을 따름이다 is formal. In casual talk, use -을 뿐이다.
잊을래야 (speech) → 잊으려야 (formal writing): In careful writing, -(으)려야 is the standard spelling. The meaning is the same.
exercises: Fill in the blank with -을래야/-ㄹ래야 and 읽다: 옆집 음악 소리가 너무 커서 책을 ____ 읽을 수가 없어요.
Fill in the blank with -을래야/-ㄹ래야 and 열다: 열쇠를 잃어버려서 문을 ____ 열 수가 없었어요.
Find and correct the mistake: 지난 주말에 일이 너무 많아서 쉴래야 쉬었어요.
Complete the formal sentence with -을 따름이다 and 기쁘다: 이렇게 큰 상을 받게 되어서 그저 ____.
Complete with the past form of -을 따름이다 and 좋다: 기자: 1등 축하드립니다! 선수: 아니에요. 그날 운이 ____.
Choose the right expression for each situation: ① 회의에서 사장님께: 부족한 저를 믿어 주셔서 (감사할 따름입니다 / 감사할래야 감사할 수 없습니다). ② 친구에게: 그 영화는 너무 무서워서 끝까지 (볼래야 볼 수가 없었어 / 볼 따름이었어).
answers: 쉴래야 쉴 수가 없었어요 (쉴래야 쉴 수 없었어요)
